plugins.name: discover
plugins.description: Product-design discovery toolkit: plan research, run it, and log evidence in one shared, parseable format.

plugins.name: define
plugins.description: Product-design definition toolkit — the product strategy workshop as a pipeline: charter, user roles, journey maps, and impact-vs-complexity opportunity prioritization. Works assumption-led when there's no research yet.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Product-design solution toolkit — pursued opportunities into briefs, divergent concepts, a decision log, flows, and testable HTML prototypes, with critique as the recurring gate against the charter. Works assumption-led when define hasn't run.
